review_kind: assistant editorial review; not participant research
scope: Static source candidates are conservative and include some non-visible selector literals. User-authored text and generated professional prompts are excluded.

perspective_matrix.first_time: Heading is an invitation; support and CTA explain prompt preparation. No automatic comprehension is promised.
perspective_matrix.returning: Only a completed action in this session selects returning copy. No elapsed-time or personal profile inference.
perspective_matrix.non_native_english: Short familiar verbs; shape is a metaphor grounded by explicit prompt wording. Native-speaker localization remains pending.
perspective_matrix.creator: Creative task selection picks editorial copy without flattering talent.
perspective_matrix.developer: Exact execution and integrity details remain under inspection/proof.
perspective_matrix.business: Goal, resources and boundaries are explicit; no ROI promise.
perspective_matrix.skeptical_expert: Editable-template operation and pending independent qualification are disclosed.
perspective_matrix.privacy_conscious: Core input stays on device during preparation; hosting sign-in and downstream AI use are distinguished.
perspective_matrix.mobile: Short action profiles; hero layout requires visual review at breakpoints.
perspective_matrix.screen_reader: Labels name the action; technical details use native disclosure controls. Accessibility certification is not claimed.

Note: this library is a prompt gallery for now. A premium daily 3D / interactive website experience is planned separately from these cards.
Build a 30-minute product sync agenda with outcomes, timeboxes, and one decision to make. Avoid status theater.
Write a 12-line poem about rain on metal roofs. Exact rhyme scheme AABB. No archaic diction.
Write a polite leave-of-absence email for two days next week. Keep it under 120 words. No medical details.
Turn a vague bug into a crisp report.
Draft a vendor negotiation email asking for a 12% discount on annual SaaS. Firm but respectful. Offer a multi-year term.
Write first-run onboarding copy for SPE: three screens, no jargon, clear privacy line, one primary action each.
Design a coaching prompt that helps me prepare a difficult feedback conversation. Ask clarifying questions before advice.
Review this English UI string list for localization hazards: concatenated sentences, humor, gender, and date formats.
Help me prepare STAR answers for a product designer interview about conflict with engineering. Keep answers under 90 seconds spoken.
Summarize a remote-work policy for employees in plain English. Separate must / should / may. Flag ambiguities.
Threat-model a browser extension that reads page text to build prompts. Assets, attackers, mitigations. Stay proportional.
Critique this mobile UI for clarity, hierarchy, and accessibility. List five concrete improvements. Mark uncertainty.
Outline a 60-second explainer video on password managers. Beats, on-screen text, and one call to action. No fearmongering.
Explain how HTTPS keeps a connection private to a curious 14-year-old. One analogy, one worked example, three check questions.
Plan a one-day walking itinerary in Lisbon for two people who dislike crowds. Include food breaks and rain backup.
Write a 150-word grant abstract for a community tool library. Problem, approach, impact, and how success is measured.
A concept for a curious teen.
Turn this into a bug report with steps, expected vs actual, and severity: sign-in button sometimes does nothing on mobile Safari.
Design a safe kitchen experiment to show density for kids age 8–10. Materials list, steps, and what we hope to observe.
Draft a blameless incident postmortem template filled for a 22-minute API outage caused by a bad config push.
Draft FAQ answers for an offline writing app: pricing, offline mode, export formats, and privacy. No marketing fluff.
Structure a portfolio case study for a banking app redesign: problem, constraints, process, outcome, and what I'd redo.
Help me plan a low-energy work week with two deep-work blocks and hard stops. Chronic fatigue friendly. No hustle tone.
List ten questions I should ask before analyzing a city open-data CSV of building permits. Cover quality, bias, and privacy.
Open a short story in a coastal town at dawn. Two characters, one secret. 200 words. No twist ending yet.
Rewrite this chart caption so it states the sample, the window, and what it does not prove. Avoid causal language.
Find a11y gaps in a flow.
Draft a support reply for a late shipment. Empathize, give two options, never invent tracking numbers.
Brief a 3D still-life: brushed metal ring, frosted glass sphere, soft north light, graphite pedestal. Camera 50mm, f/4.
Outline a research brief on urban heat islands and tree canopy. List questions, evidence needs, and what would falsify the claim.
Write an image-generation brief for a quiet ceramic workshop at dusk. Specify lighting, lens, palette, and what to avoid.
Review the TypeScript I paste for correctness, security, and maintainability. Rank findings by severity with concrete fixes. Do not invent files.
Create a 7-day study plan for introductory statistics. 45 minutes a day. Include one practice problem each day.
Propose information architecture for a habit tracker with five primary destinations. Justify what is not in the tab bar.
Propose a stepwise refactor plan for a legacy React class component to hooks. Preserve behavior. List risks and tests.
Help me write a PostgreSQL query for monthly active users with clear assumptions and indexes to consider. No destructive statements.
Review this checkout flow description for WCAG-minded gaps: focus order, labels, errors, and color-only cues. Prioritize fixes.
Write a short privacy notice for a local-first prompt tool: what stays on device, what never leaves, and what is optional.
Sketch a REST API for a personal notes app: resources, auth assumptions, error shapes. No implementation code yet.
